mapper.sql: request_stocks.id AS id, request_stocks.company_id AS companyId, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM transfer_orders WHERE transfer_orders.status IN (2, 3) AND transfer_orders.request_stock_id = request_stocks.id AND request_stocks.status > 0 ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isNotAllowDisapproved, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM transfer_orders WHERE transfer_orders.status > 0 AND transfer_orders.request_stock_id = request_stocks.id AND request_stocks.status > 0 ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isHavingTransfer, companies.name AS companyName, request_stocks.date AS requestDate, request_stocks.code AS requestNumber, from_location.id AS fromWarehouseId, from_location.name AS fromWarehouseName, to_location.name AS toWarehouseName, to_location.id AS toWarehouseId, request_stocks.note AS note, request_stocks.status AS status, request_stocks.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, request_stocks.created AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy, request_stocks.is_approve AS isApproved, CONCAT(approver.first_name, ' ', approver.last_name) AS approvedBy, request_stocks.approved AS approved

FROM request_stocks LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = request_stocks.company_id LEFT JOIN location_groups AS from_location ON from_location.id = request_stocks.from_location_group_id LEFT JOIN location_groups AS to_location ON to_location.id = request_stocks.to_location_group_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = request_stocks.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = request_stocks.modified_by LEFT JOIN users AS approver ON approver.id = request_stocks.approved_by
mapper.select:

SELECT request_stock_details.request_stock_id AS requestStockId, request_stock_details.product_id AS productId, request_stock_details.qty AS qty, pro.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate, pro.code AS upc, pro.barcode AS sku, pro.name AS productName, request_stock_details.qty_uom_id AS qtyUomId, uoms.name AS uom FROM request_stock_details LEFT JOIN products AS pro ON pro.id = request_stock_details.product_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = request_stock_details.qty_uom_id WHERE request_stock_details.request_stock_id = #{id}
